name: move_to
summary: Send your drone to a location and wait until it arrives.

name: nearest_ore
summary: Find the closest ore patch and return a target you can use with move_to().

name: mine
summary: Mine ore at your current location. Blocks until one ore is extracted.

name: cargo
summary: Return how much ore the drone is currently carrying.

name: capacity
summary: Return the maximum ore the drone can hold (5 for Mission 01).

name: deposit
summary: Deposit all your cargo at the base. Blocks until complete.
